game.name: Sniper Elite V2 (USA)
game.desc: Sniper Elite V2 is a third-person shooter for Xbox 360. Karl Fairburne must infiltrate the last German defences at the end of the Second World War. The title features an exclusive "killcam" that rewards the player's best shots by tracking the bullet's trajectory. This process will allow the player to see the damage the bullet does to the target's skeleton through X-ray vision.
